# Wand of the War Mage +1 (`magic-items:wand-of-the-war-mage-1`)
**Category:** [Wands](../equipment-categories/wands.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes | **Limited to:** Spellcaster | **Variant:** Yes

Wand

Uncommon (+1)

While holding this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore Half Cover when making a spell attack roll.
